 Honda Avancier Officially Revealed: Toyota Fortuner Challenger Is Finally Here! 
 Honda Avancier Officially Revealed: Toyota Fortuner Challenger Is Finally Here!
 Written By: Ajeesh Kuttan Published: November 20, 2026 at 10:22 AM Updated: November 20, 2026 at 10:22 AM After releasing multiple teasers, Honda finally unveiled its all-new SUV, the Avancier, globally. The Honda Avancier is a three-row SUV, and it has been developed under the concept of Grand-Journey. The all-new Honda Avancier will initially be launched in Asian markets, including Thailand, Japan, and China. It is a full size SUV that will compete with the likes of Toyota Fortuner in the segment.
 Exterior
 The exterior design of the Avancier is actually different from any Honda SUV that we have seen to date. It looks sporty, and Honda has managed to come up with a design that looks premium and aggressive at the same time.
 The front gets an upright design with sleek dual-function LED DRLs right under the bonnet. Like most modern SUVs, the Avancier also gets a split headlamp setup with LED lights and a bold grille. The new Honda logo is also seen on the grille. There are faux skid plates that add muscle to the overall look of the vehicle. We do see front parking sensors and a camera at the front.
 Moving to the side, the SUV gets a smooth-flowing boxy design with large windows. There are thick black claddings around the wheel arches and 20-inch alloy wheels with a sport multi-spoke design. The door handles are flush-fitting, and we do not see a lot of chrome anywhere on the vehicle.
 As we move to the rear, Honda has gone for a Range Rover-like sleek LED design for the tail lamps. They are vertically placed on the left and right corners of the rear fender, and just like the front, the rear of the vehicle also gets an almost vertical design with a tilted windshield. There is an integrated roof spoiler with a concealed wiper in it.
 Interior
 The SUV has been designed on the basis of the Grand-Journey concept, and this means the Honda Avancier gets a cabin that is spacious, welcoming, and premium. It is a three-row SUV, and Honda is offering an entirely new design for the cabin. The SUV gets an ice grey and black theme for the cabin, which gives it a premium feel.
 Honda claims that the Avancier gets an uncluttered and spacious design for the first row, a relaxing and limousine-like high-quality environment and space for the second row, and an easily accessible third row with a decent amount of space.
 In terms of features, Honda is offering an all-new flat-button steering wheel with the new Honda logo in the centre. There is a large touchscreen infotainment system. Surprisingly, Honda is not offering many physical buttons, as they are now integrated into the screen. The SUV has soft-touch materials on the dashboard, and we also have ambient lights that enhance the overall look of the cabin.
 The SUV gets a digital driver display, and it also comes with a premium 12-speaker system from Bose compatible with Dolby Atmos. The SUV is also offering features like remote in-cabin view and remote surround-view function. Apart from the usual features, the SUV will offer automatic climate control, leatherette upholstery, seat ventilation and heating functions, electrically adjustable seats with a memory function, panoramic sunroof, AC vents for all rows, wireless phone charging pad, electric parking brake, Level 2 ADAS, and so on. The SUV has been designed for markets like China and we believe Honda is unlikely to bring to India.
 Powertrain
 The Honda Avancier, as mentioned above, is based on a new platform, and it uses Honda’s next-generation hybrid system. The all-new Avancier is the first Honda model to feature the DualPower eAWD electric all-wheel-drive system, which drives and controls the front and rear wheels independently using separate motors. The front and rear motors deliver powerful acceleration from a stop, while precise distribution of driving force according to driving conditions ensures excellent driving stability.
 It uses a 2.0-litre petrol-hybrid engine, and with the new two-motor system in place, the Honda Avancier offers higher efficiency and better driving pleasure. The engine is mated to an e-CVT as standard.
